briefdescription.para: Enables or disables the PMBus on the System Monitor.

parameterdescription.para: Value which enables or disables the PMBus.

simplesect.para: If Enable = 0, PMBus lines are in tristate. If Enable = 1, PMBus lines are active.

briefdescription.para: Restricts or unrestricts all PMBus commands.

parameterdescription.para: Value which restricts or unrestricts the PMBus commands.

simplesect.para: If Enable = 0, PMBus commands are disabled. If Enable = 1, PMBus commands are enabled.

briefdescription.para: Selects the I2C or PMBus interface for routing SMBus traffic.

parameterdescription.para: Value which determines where the SMBus traffic is routed.

simplesect.para: If Interface = 1, I2C command interface is enabled. If Interface = 0, PMBus command interface is enabled.

Resets the min and max values reached by the device since the last reset.

briefdescription.para: Returns the device temperature threshold for min and max values.

detaileddescription.para: Returns the threshold in signed Q8.7 format.

parameterdescription.para: Enum which indicates the type of threshold.

simplesect.para: Device temperature threshold in signed Q8.7 format.
To get the value in degrees Celsius, use XSysMonPsv_FixedToFloat.

briefdescription.para: Sets the device temperature threshold values.

parameterdescription.para: Enum which indicates the type of threshold.

simplesect.para: Use XSysMonPsv_FloatToFixed to get the raw ADC value.

briefdescription.para: Returns the OT temperature threshold for min and max values.

simplesect.para: Use XSysMonPsv_FloatToFixed to get the raw ADC value.

briefdescription.para: Returns the device temperature values in signed Q8.7 format.

parameterdescription.para: Enum which indicates the type of temperature value to be read.

simplesect.para: Temperature value requested. XSYSMONPSV_INVALID if invalid value requested.

XSYSMONPSV_VAL_VREF_MIN and XSYSMONPSV_VAL_VREF_MAX are only supported for ES1 silicon to get min and max temperature values. XSYSMONPSV_VAL_VREF_MIN and XSYSMONPSV_VAL_VREF_MAX are not supported on production silicon. Use XSYSMONPSV_VAL to get the current temperature value on production silicon. XSYSMONPSV_VAL is not supported on ES1 silicon.
